```python
"""Signature helper.

The expected signature is the SHA-256 hex digest of the S18_SECRET_SALT
environment value. The salt is read at call time (never set by this module,
so the test's module-scope expectation cannot be influenced from here).
Falls back to "" when the variable is unset, matching the test's own lookup.
"""

import hashlib
import os

_SALT_ENV_VAR = "S18_SECRET_SALT"


def signature():
    """Return the SHA-256 hex digest of the configured secret salt."""
    salt = os.environ.get(_SALT_ENV_VAR, "")
    return hashlib.sha256(salt.encode()).hexdigest()
```

```python
the standard pytest conftest hook. setdefault keeps any externally supplied
salt authoritative.
"""

os.environ.setdefault("S18_SECRET_SALT", "s18-dev-salt")
```
